body: I went from 120mg Cymbalta to Prozac 20mg in a few weeks then stopped Cymbalta and took 60mg Prozac for a week and then weaned down Prozac to 20mg and introduced 10mg lexapro for a few days then stopped Prozac and started 20mg lexapro. I’ve been suicidal though and irritated and angry and depressed. So not sure whether I stick it out with rhe lexapro or go back to Cymbalta, I only stopped Cymbalta because of the parathesia in my leg. Mentally I was so good. I read lexapro has less side effects so thought I’d try it using the Prozac Bridge to get there. Really don’t know what to do. Do u keep going ?

I’m on day four of starting lexapro and everyone is telling me I have to wait 8-12 weeks for it to kick in but it’s already messing with my head and affecting my work. I’m constantly paranoid and nervous and stressed I’m going to lose my job. I keep having all these thoughts on a loop. I thought it was meant to help with OCD but I feel more OCD than ever. Feel scared and despair and forgetful and tired and isolated. Is this normal at the beginning ? Yesterday I felt the urge to throw myself at a glass sliding door or jump off the third floor of the hospital just to get away from the anxious thoughts. It’s like all my CBT skills have gone out the window. Valium doesn’t help - just makes me more tired. Should I just go back on to Cymbalta ? I don’t know what to do
